entities.label: Person
entities.summary: María Martina Ibaibarriaga Elorriaga was a Spanish guerrilla leader during the Peninsular War (1807–14). A legend later grew up that she pretended to be a man, enlisted in the Spanish army, and rose to the rank of lieutenant colonel.
